title: Persistent identity store
summary: Every identity profile lives in ~/.yoke-browser-identities/<project>/<identity> on every machine, outside ~/.yoke, so a reset that clears ~/.yoke keeps it. The first profile creates the store owner-only. A store that is a link or a file, or cannot be created, refuses browser_identity_store_unavailable. A profile left at the legacy path under ~/.yoke/secrets/capability-secrets moves into the store; when both copies exist the command refuses browser_identity_store_conflict. This fixes remote yoke browser authorize --test-machine leaving profiles where a reset cleared them. Live proof on real hosts is still owed.
